title: The 1783 Law That Classified Babies as Government Property

why_this_can_go_viral: Shocks viewers with the idea that the state once claimed ownership of all children, triggering outrage and shares.

why_this_can_go_viral: The absurdity of being killed for singing creates strong emotional reaction and curiosity.
